in_marathi.name: Keya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Keya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Keya is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kāy', which means 'desire' or 'longing'. In Hindu mythology, it is also the name of a nymph or apsara, who personifies desire and longing in the human heart. The name is often given to girls who are believed to embody these qualities.
